skill.name: seo-analysis
skill.description: SEO analysis and optimization specialist. Use when conducting technical SEO audits, optimizing meta tags, analyzing Core Web Vitals, or improving search engine rankings. Focuses on actionable recommendations.
skill.summary: Guides technical SEO audits, metadata optimization, Core Web Vitals review, and search visibility improvements.
skill.author: Joseph OBrien

content.value_statement: SEO work often spans technical checks, metadata, performance, and structured data. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical SEO audits and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Reviews technical SEO areas such as URL structure, sitemaps, canonicals, redirects, HTTPS, crawlability, and mobile usability.
Suggests title tags, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, Twitter Card tags, and structured data improvements.
Checks Core Web Vitals targets for LCP, FID, and CLS and recommends performance improvements.
Helps plan schema markup and internal linking improvements for search visibility.
Produces actionable audit summaries with current-state notes, optimized recommendations, and expected impact.
limitations: It does not crawl a live website by itself unless the host agent provides page content or tool access.
It does not replace analytics platforms, search console data, or specialist SEO judgment.
It cannot guarantee ranking changes because search results depend on many external factors.
It may need current performance metrics before making accurate Core Web Vitals recommendations.

use_cases.title: Audit a Client Website
use_cases.description: Run a structured review of technical SEO, metadata, mobile usability, and crawlability before a client handoff.

use_cases.title: Improve Landing Page Metadata
use_cases.description: Create stronger titles, descriptions, and social sharing metadata for important campaign pages.

use_cases.title: Prioritize Technical Fixes
use_cases.description: Turn Core Web Vitals, indexing, and structured data issues into clear implementation priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Basic SEO Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page for basic SEO issues. Focus on title tags, descriptions, headings, crawlability, and mobile usability.

prompt_templates.title: Metadata Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize the metadata for this page. Provide improved title, description, social sharing text, and the reason for each change.

prompt_templates.title: Core Web Vitals Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these Core Web Vitals results. Explain the likely causes, rank the fixes by impact, and list practical next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Full Technical SEO Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a full technical SEO audit using the provided site details. Cover crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, structured data, internal links, and performance.

output_examples.input: Audit a SaaS homepage with a generic title, missing description, and weak social metadata.
output: Identifies the generic title as a click-through risk.
Recommends a clearer search title and concise description.
Suggests Open Graph text that matches the page value proposition.

output_examples.input: Review Core Web Vitals for a product page with slow LCP and layout shifts.
output: Prioritizes image loading, server response time, and layout stability checks.
Explains why each issue may affect search performance and user experience.
Groups fixes into immediate, near-term, and follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Plan SEO improvements for a content hub with weak internal links.
output: Maps key topics to supporting pages.
Recommends internal link anchors that reflect search intent.
Flags pages that may need canonical or indexation review.

best_practices: Provide page content, current metadata, performance metrics, and crawl notes for the most accurate audit.
Ask for prioritized recommendations when implementation time or engineering resources are limited.
Validate suggested metadata, schema, and redirects in staging before publishing changes.
anti_patterns: Do not expect ranking guarantees from any single audit or metadata update.
Do not optimize titles and descriptions without matching the page content and search intent.
Do not treat Core Web Vitals suggestions as final without measuring real user and lab data.

faq.question: Can this skill perform a live crawl?
faq.answer: It can analyze crawl data or page content you provide. Live crawling depends on the tools available to the host agent.

faq.question: Does it write schema markup recommendations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend structured data opportunities and explain where they support search visibility.

faq.question: Can it help with Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews LCP, FID, and CLS targets and suggests practical performance improvements.

faq.question: Is it useful for content SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review metadata, headings, internal links, and search intent alignment for content pages.

faq.question: Will it guarantee higher rankings?
faq.answer: No. It provides optimization guidance, but rankings depend on competition, authority, search behavior, and external search engine changes.

faq.question: Which agents can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
